headline: Set October 27, 2026 hearings on 37 Enon Street apartments and a data center moratorium; adopted FY2027 affordable housing fee.
summary: The board recommended that the City Council accept a portion of Millbrook Road as a public way. It endorsed subdivision approval not required plans for 23 Cressy Street and adopted the Fiscal Year 2027 fee in lieu of affordable housing units. It set an October 27, 2026 public hearing on a project at 37 Enon Street and on a proposed temporary moratorium on data center use.
decisions: Recommended to the City Council that a portion of Millbrook Road between 15 and 51 Millbrook Road be accepted as a public way, 4-0.
Endorsed the Subdivision Approval Not Required Plans for 23 Cressy Street, 4-0.
Adopted the Fiscal Year 2027 Fee in Lieu of Affordable Housing Units, as presented, 4-0.
Set a public hearing for October 27, 2026 on Site Plan Review #171-26, Special Permit #207-26, and Inclusionary Housing Application #31-26 for 37 Enon Street, 4-0.
Set a public hearing for October 27, 2026 on City Council Order #TBD, a temporary moratorium on data center use, 4-0.
Approved the minutes of September 15, 2026, as amended, 4-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to recommend to the City Council that they accept the portion of Millbrook Road between 15 and 51 Millbrook Road as a public way. Bartley seconds. Motion carries unanimously (4-0).
Motion to endorse the Subdivision Approval Not Required Plans for 23 Cressy Street. Bartley seconds. Motion carries unanimously (4-0).
Motion to adopt the Fiscal Year 2027 Fee in Lieu of Affordable Housing Units, as presented. Bartley seconds. Motion carries unanimously (4-0).

Motion to set a Public Hearing for October 27, 2026, for the Site Plan Review #171-26, Special Permit #207-26, and Inclusionary Housing Application #31-26 for 37 Enon Street. Bartley seconds. Motion carries unanimously (4-0).
Motion to set a Public Hearing for October 27, 2026, for the City Council Order #TBD. Bartley seconds. Motion carries unanimously (4-0).
Motion to approve the meeting minutes of September 15, 2026, as amended. Lee seconds. Motion carries unanimously (4-0).
